summary: Build the formal core of the soil-carbon accounting used by the Global Soil Intelligence Platform (GSIP): the steady state and geometric approach of a one-pool turnover model, and the overstatement that a fixed-depth stock comparison makes when bulk density changes, each sealed as a statement under the standing sealing policy and proved under the pinned Lean toolchain.
title: Soil carbon: turnover, steady state and the equivalent-soil-mass correction
